author: Notar
category: couch cookie. Like a couch potato except cookie.
description:
“Often found lying on the floor surrounded by cookies and some method to watch streams of Ninomae Ina’nis of Hololive English. Although called a ‘couch’ cookie, they are more often found lying on a floor. This misnomer comes from the first few sightings of them on couches, but we now know the couch cookie will sleep on many surfaces, beds, floors, sometimes tables. 

This species of takodachi has been spotted consuming massive amounts of cookies while not moving from its place of rest. Despite this, the couch cookie does not gain mass, this is likely due to the connection with the void. 

It is a rare occurrence to witness the couch cookie move from its position, and only a few documented cases have been recorded. This is usually done to either change its sleeping point to a cooler area or to restock its cookie pile, at which point, the couch cookie will lie down once more and settle to watch streams of Ninomae Ina’nis from Hololive English.

However, in secret, even fewer sightings are seen of the couch cookie spreading awareness of their priestess through comments and posts on other sites, furthering the silent movement of WAHrld domINAtion as all takodachis do”

author: Husker
description: Content to drift in the calmer currents, this Tako watches from the shadows of the reef, its presence felt more than seen. Though rarely at the forefront, it remains ever loyal to the Priestess, offering silent support through every voyage. When the tides of celebration come, it surfaces with a gentle wave, reminding all that the deep still holds many faithful hearts.

author: Asarai
description: "One of many, this Tako gathers cute and comfortable stuff Like A Dragon and it's pile of gold. Although it remains unseen most of the time, it shows support in its' own comfy ways by silently watching and cheering occasionally whilst drowning in the comfortable depths of their pillows."

author: Kodithehoomanshark🌙🥐
name: Takohoomanshark🐙🦉🦈
category: Tako commander of the second batalion takochi
description:
A loyal follower of the Priestess, this Tako is a very high ranking tako in the tako nation, it is said that only ten Tako commanders are left in the nation. THERE WERE ORIGINALY 100 OF THEM BEFORE THE GREAT Rampage In Atlantis 90 Of Them We're WIPED OUT DUE to the power gap between the Takos and the Priestess rampaging form. 

Class:batalion commander
Attributes: smol and cute

author: HiloNero
description: * A mysterious tiny Takodachi whose name and appearance are only whispered among the shadows. Their stories are scattered across the world, each recounting a tiny piece of the road that they travel. The most common detail between all of them is that they always prominently use a sharp nail-like weapon and wear a mask akin to a crescent moon. However, recently, a new prophecy was revealed detailing about the Tako's upcoming appearance...

author: Fluid
name: 74k0d4chi
description: "Surviving solely in digital spaces, this elusive Tako may be spotted wherever software produces unintended results. Prefers to live in places where its shenanigans cause delights instead of concern, like Bethesda games. Finding one at your workplace, however, is a sign of bad luck."

author: Synnrad AKA Eric
name: Synnrad AKA Eric
description: "Devout follower of the Priestess, this Tako doesn't always know what to focus on aside from watching the Priestess when she streams. Can bake many types of treats and is also a good troubleshooter for tech. It yearns to be more social at times, but its battery can drain fast."

author: Nameless (They/Them)
name: Ari AKA Nameless
description: "This tako is in a constant evolution, gathering info and increasing their abilities, all with the express purpose of maximizing cookie consumption. At present, they are very limited, but that has never stopped from trying their best in the face of everything."

author: Tornhalo
name: Tornhalo
description: “This Tako is known to hold many stories it collected as it wanders the void. It likes to share its stories with any and all that wish to hear them. Be it other takos or friendly humans that encounter it.”

author: NowaruArt
name: Cattodachi
description: One of the Takodachi that is very different from the others, with pointy flaps and a tail. This Tako is very similar to Feline / Cat, which is why this Tako is named "Catto"dachi! Cattodachi is very shy at first, but once trust is gained, this Tako loves staying close to them. Cattodachi also loves drawing and is always trying its best to get attention from its Priestess by showing off its drawing skills and improvements!

author: Endactam
category: Wrench user.  Attributes: Green, standard tako shape.  *This tako takes things that are  not supposed to work together and makes them function as one.  Machines are easy. If they are broken fix them, if they are too slow upgrade them.  People are difficult.
description: *This tako takes things that are  not supposed to work together and makes them function as one.  Machines are easy. If they are broken fix them, if they are too slow upgrade them.  People are difficult.

author: Vantablack
description:
"A versatile bait effective for attracting a wide variety of fish species. Prior to casting it as bait, one must first offer the Tako a cookie. Without it, the creature will promptly retreat to its nest, curl up, and fall into a deep sleep, making it unsuitable for fishing.

Note: Experienced anglers advise keeping a small pouch of cookies on hand, in case the Tako refuses to cooperate at a crucial moment."

author: Huros
description:
A tako that turned into a soft, warm blanket. He loves cuddling with other takos, rainy afternoons, and movie nights.

He always stays clean because he feeds on the cookie crumbs and milk stains that fall on him.

author: Chumbeque
name: Chumbeque
description: "A very shy Tako who struggle to speak until help is needed specially for the priestess and his fellows takodachis"

author: Gathog
name: Takonfect
description:
"Inspired by Ina's cooking, this Tako learned the arts of baking all kinds of sweets.
Its goal is to find the ultimate cookie recipe and use it to supply their fellow Takos."

author: Ren
name: Takoband
description:
"A Tako that disguises itself as a hairband, quietly perching atop its host's head. Occasionally, it will manipulate its host to create more of its kinds and distribute them to random people, especially those who gather during certain fes. Those who wear the ‘Takoband’ (willingly) soon find themselves...changed. Converted. ONE OF US!"

"World Domination for the Priestess! WAH!"

author: Reyk
name: We Are Wahn
description:
Category/
"A bunch of takos, who got inspiration from old traditional Sentai, Yuusha Ina, and Inside Out(lol), decided one day that they should build a robot and name it Takozord(international copyright laws won't allow them to use the name Megazord..)They believe that through unity, combination of braincells and all for one, it would help them achieve much more cookies, togethaa

author: KiwiNeko
name: KiwiNeko
description: "This Tako dreams of attending HoloFes in-person someday to cheer on all the talents and witness the hype. Thus far his work schedule as an internal medicine resident has not been cooperative. Nevertheless, he remains hopeful for next year and prays to the gacha gods for favorable scheduling!"

author: Arthain
name: Arthain
description: "No matter the pain, no matter the difficulty, even as the scars accumulate this Tako always gets the job done. The soft, malleable form allows it to adapt to nearly any situation that comes their way, although it'd really rather just relax and roll around in a bed as soft as they are."

author: yanagiarisa
name: yanagiarisa
attributes: Airhead but loyal, likes to munch
description: A loyal follower of the cult and its priestess. Will give free handmade onigiris to fellow takos and ina with a side of calpico. Will be commonly seen in a box swiping credit cards for their waifu and husbandos while eating onigiri

author: Neminem
name: Patter Of Takos
attributes: Squishy, Cuddly, & Multiple Hands for Patting Tako Heads
description: When Ina doesn't have time to pat the tako heads, this tako pats the tako heads until Ina returns. Will grow more hands depending on Tako Headpat demands. When not patting takos, this tako uses the hands to do programming faster (because that's how it works in the TV shows right?).

author: Sock
name: Sock
description: This Tako makes regular use of it's shapeshifting powers to spread good vibes and cheer, all in the aid of the priestess' peaceful takeover and in support of her and her friends.

author: LasagnaLaffeydiction
description: "This Tako is eternaly sleepy and loves the floor. He wishes for his priestess to rest more."

author: Takomonty
name: Takomonty
description: "A perpetually tired tako run ragged by work and scholarly pursuits. It finds comfort in painting, jetpacks, and bardic ballads. It is often strangely silent, and communicates primarily through illustration rather than words; though some say that a picture is worth a thousand wahs"

author: vignedev
name: vignedev
description: "Tako with an unrestricted access to Elixirs of the Undying, ready to jump into action, even when their physical form is screaming in agony. Due to said condition however, they'll often take long breaks, resulting in tasks being done at the last minute, but always on time."

author: Ironsigh
name: Ironsigh
description:
"This Tako is actually a sentient swarm of nanites. After stumbling into some of the Priestess streams, further observation was deemed necessary, so it assumed the malleable and versatile form of a Takodachi, to help blend in, so it can observe and learn more of her wholesome views, cozy streams and with some luck, the hidden knowledge of the Potato ways.
Being surrounded by fellow Takos, in such a nice community, decided to settle down amongst them, ready to support Ina and her endeavors whenever it was possible.

While quiet in nature, it will always cheer loudly for the Priestess it has chosen to follow"

author: LynsDoodles
name: TakoGrem
description: "A mixture of a Grem and Takodachi that was also thrown into a pixel converter. How did this happen no one really knows. All that matters is that they are here, and ready to show their devotion towards the priestess with a dash of chaos!!!"

author: chuunilord
description: "(Not so rare) Tako of the sleepless variety, by now it's blood has been entirely replaced by a certain liquid made of roasted beans, only the priestess's voice can temporarily rouse it from it's constant near dead state"

author: Cortes
name: Eepydachi
description: "Its perfectly spherical shape allows this tako to move around as much as it wants with minimal effort, even though stopping might prove difficult. It follows the flow of the world, influencing others to do the same  and walk down the path of true potato. (Disclaimer: will still flap around when required)

author: Tonster117
description: This Takodachi loves finding bugs and munching on them. So much so it even tries to eat bugs that it finds in video games

author: Flagicepic
name: The Enhancer
description: "All cookies need milk in order to maximize their tasty potential. This Tako will make sure that each cookie comes with the right amount of milk! It uses magic to transfer milk from its infinite milk backpack to the cookies. It's very whimsical and loves to party and drink (milk)"

author: RickyT713
description: By day, a humble worker. By night, builds a nest on a chair or couch to enjoy snacks and enjoy video games and watch favorite streamers. Known to share snacks and give game tips to those in need and a shoulder to lean on if needed. WARNING: WILL CRY TEARS OF JOY when seeing their favorite idols (including a certain priestess) acheive their dreams and shine for all to see.

author: RemixDave
name: RemixDave
description: "Known as the one who fixes computers through electrical aura... computers recognise that there will be a zap or a formatting if they don't comply and so give up and comply."

author: Lethargic
name: Kumodachi
description: Loyal takodachis that previously assisted Ina in vanquishing an contagious light. Aids in providing damage to any enemy and always comes in numbers. Wears a durable battle mask resembling a certain tribe of spiders. Uses leaps and their sharpened tentacles to disorient enemies while dealing gradual damage. Said to be able to transform into their spider form but has yet to do so. Apparently, Ina herself came up with the name.

author: Wydken
name: Rider Tako
description: A master of tranquility, this Takodachi has unlocked the secret art of ultimate chill. Through his bond with the noble Capybara, he has achieved perfect harmony, moving in effortless synchrony with his companion. Like a mikan resting gently on top, he has become one with the Capybara Zen itself.

author: The Shiv Spoon
description: "This Tako prefers to solve problems head on, and leaps directly into the heart of battle, overwhelming opponents with power and force of will. This also leads to them getting in over their head, and requiring them to adapt to the situation, and come up with plans on the fly"

author: OutOfRice
name: RicelessTako
description: Born pixelated, this takodachi spent years learning its place in the world. Along the way, it has become a farmer but could never seem to keep its grains of rice around for longer than a day. It prefers to sleep on its downtime.

author: Alloy Automaton
name: Alloy Automaton
description: "An ancient magical automaton with the form of a Tako, it moves like a tako, feels like a tako, WAHs like a tako, it is a tako. Right?"

author: Minja
name: Minja
description: "Just a sleepy Tako trying to make ends meet. This Tako tends to avoid doing work and then needing to stay up late trying to finish work that should have been done long ago. The Priestess is a great inspiration for this Tako in the ways of both comfy and Potato."

author: RCSI
name: Glass Dome Tako
description: “Takos can be anything we want, this tako is a large glass dome meant to host hundreds of takos and one day, Ina, for those evening parties while watching the sun set knowing they’ve done a good job.”

author: Overseer Olive
name: Pixel Tako
description: "A pixelated Takodachi from a distant 2D land. Even in far off places, the word of the Priestess is heard. This carefree Tako wanders into danger, never shying away from battle. Even if it means having to 'go next' again and again."

author: Creau
name: Iris
description: "Usually found in the wild or inside storehouses, this Tako loves studying (eating), and foraging (also eating) ingredients. Depending on its diet, the flower on it's head can emits varying effects it uses to help or harm others. The glasses it wears are purely cosmetic."

author: DHugo
name: Tako Engineer
description: "Just a junior engineer from the cookie engineering department, this Tako wants to create an infinite cookie machine so all Tako can eat cookie everyday! Sadly he's not in control of the one braincell right now so he doesn't know what he's doing."

author: kshut (@shutowl)
name: pebbledachi
description: "A rare species of devout followers who have had both their sanity and emotions desensitized over many years. Without limbs for efficient movement, they move in packs by rolling their rock-like bodies. However this is uncommon, as they would much rather stay inside, away from the predatory "extraverts"."

author: Photoncord
name: Obsession
description: This Tako secretes a sticky substance from its tentacles to latch onto any moving objects it detects. However, its tendency to doze off often leads to it finding itself in unfamiliar places with no memory of how or why it ended up there.

author: PureTako
name: The Bountiful One
description: "This is a glass-container-like takodachi that changes shape. It turns into whatever you put inside it. If you pour orange juice into it, the whole container becomes an orange. If you put a cookie inside it, the entire container turns into a cookie. It transforms to match exactly what it holds, depends on what you like to put in."

author: Machi says WAH
name: Takomachi
description: "A smol yellow Tako that collects cute Ina moments as a weapon to Win All Hearts for the Glory of Tentacult and progressing WAHrld domINAtion \(≧▽≦ )/"

author: SleepDeprivedFae
name: FaeTako
description: "Appearing in secluded woodlands, this Tako joins the mortal plane for one purpose only: mischief. They play a variety of pranks on unsuspecting travelers, always moving just on the edge of vision. While chaotic, these Takos do not seek to harm."

author: Teo
name: Teo
category: Artist Attributes: Small/chill, this tako likes to space out while drawing, chilling in the floor with his tablet, this tako can finish a Fanart in the spawn of 3 months(the fastest that he has ever be) his hobby is drawing while watching Ina streams.
attributes: Small/chill, this tako likes to space out while drawing, chilling in the floor with his tablet, this tako can finish a Fanart in the spawn of 3 months(the fastest that he has ever be) his hobby is drawing while watching Ina streams.

author: junblebee
name: tako-bee
description: A simple Tako follower of the Priestess

author: Haru
description: "Wants to be apart of everything, but can't keep up with all that's going on. However, always smiling through it all as being in the community of takos is more than enough to keep this little guy satisfied. Loves Gartic Phone!"

author: MiJi
name: MiJi
attributes: pure?/HAve like Takenoko no Sato of devil horns
description: ''Attracted by the purple-haired priest's paintings, and believes that being with him will bring happiness.''

author: Remism
name: Beecat
category: cat attributes: red, chill face kinda lazy, wide
attributes: red, chill face kinda lazy, wide

author: Lustigkurre
description: "Hiding behind a greatshield, ready to counter any attacks. This Tako never attacks first but is always ready to defend its allies."

author: Corp.Shephard
name: Corp.Shephard
description: A Tako with a fondness for large hats.  One of the WAHndering Takos who like to travel far and wide in search of new cookies and to support of the Priestess' inscrutable world domINAtion.  Said to have a thousand plans to crack the cookie jar, but has never used a single one.  Is it out of respect for the Priestess... or laziness?

author: Melmarkt
name: Melmarkt
description: "As the guard of the jar, this Tako is responsible for keeping the cookie jar safe. Although being near the jar is a tempting situation, and a Tako is always a Tako. So it bakes cookies to refill the jar and creates a seemingly endless cookie jar."

author: eLun
name: eLudachi
description: "A Tako known for their amazing prowess to be lazy and stay comfy. Due to their profound magecraft they are able to navigate through any space/time without being seen or noticed. Making them the perfect Tako for information gathering in the safest and efficient way."

author: Eric :3
name: Eric
description: “This Takodachi, having spent years painting and playing with miniatures, has developed a tactical prowess in both artistic and gameplay elements. As a consequence of sitting at its desk painting for most of the day, this Takodachi has devolved into being a squishy blob, but surprisingly, it still has shaky tentacles. This is a very chill and kind hearted Takodachi, please do not break his miniatures.”

author: ProxyZeus
name: ProxyZeus
attributes: Made of approximately 500kb and really wants all your browser cookies
description: "He loves to lounge around different websites and then multiply himself when someone visits to consume their browser cookies"

author: John Weeb
description: "Hoarding many different items, is this Takos bread and butter. Once it sets it's eyes on an object it will do anything in it's power to add it to their hoard, wich is later used to build their home. However, it always makes sure to provide something in exchange in case the item arleady has an owner."

author: shadow
name: shadoWAH
description: “Blending into crowds of Takos, this Tako is a master of disguise and emulates behaviours perfectly. It is sometimes playful and uses its abilities to steal cookies but usually has a target and moves from place to place. Over the years, it has gained a bounty on it but it enjoys the heightened thrill of the chase.”

author: Thocclord
name: Thocclord
description:
"Once a dormant Tako who followed the doctrines of the Void without question. But the life it was given never fit, and the search for something more led the Tako to the Tentacult’s beloved Priestess, through whom it gained a physical form.

Now newly awakened, its tentacles can take on a dazzling range of complex tasks --
delicate, intricate, almost impossible. A perfect Tako if one ignores its tendency to overanalyze every decision until it succumbs to cognitive overload and many limbs falter under the weight of its own scrutiny."

author: A random casual
name: Casual
description: "An introverted and chill Takodachi, it tends to stay indoors most of the time eating cookies, but there are few occasions where it will gather with other Takos for important gatherings, mainly related to praising the Priestess."

author: Valawari
name: vawadachi
description: “This deep sea tako likes to lurk in the shadows in the comfort of its cozy bed (better to focus on drawing !!!). Despite its soft and squishy exterior, do NOT touch this tako, if you get too close it might bite”

author: McArkus
name: McArkus
description: A tako that likes to be comfy watching streams, but will rise to the challenge if a problem is presented that needs solution, just don’t forget the cookies

author: Joakim MF
name: Uni 3d modelling handin Tako
description: "A novice at shapeshifting, this takodachi has made use of these skills to help its fellows, by supplying them with tape, however it's not quite figured the job out and the tape tends to get stuck in the wrong place"

author: Vanilla Thunder
name: Eventer Tako
description: “Known to travel great distances for live performances, this Tako is ironically very hard to spot in its supposed native habitat (although it’s in denial of that fact if you ask it). Observed to move at lightning speed when it involves hobbies it enjoys, practically immobile for anything else. Has a 5.20% chance of getting stunlocked in shame when you point out it basically lives on planes (1 day CD per person).”

author: DarkNess2101
name: TakoMallow
description:
A white Tako that love chilling under the apple tree (surely not for eating free apples!). It looks quite lazy, but when it comes to work, it takes seriously and fully locks in. It really just wants to lie down to enjoy its day while waiting for its Priestess to return.

Class: Tank
Attributes: Aggressive / Close

Once locking in, this Tako isn't afraid of facing enemy at close range combat. It's willing to protect everyone from danger. However, the aggressiveness is too much it may forget its left and right. it can react to movements extremely fast that it can parry almost everything. It's quite soft though.

author: NxKarim
name: NxZeroTako
description: "The Takodachi is the form of a human mind and soul digitized to become a bringer of balance. After meeting the Ancient One’s priestess, he took on this form to learn from her teachings of being cute, enjoying chill moments, patience, and perseverance. His experience as a Takodachi has begun fusing his two conflicting sides deep within. While the outside reflects the balance he must maintain, inside it is all the same purple, just like a tako."

author: zeroyaka
name: TakOverworked
description: "A master of multitasking and finishing work at the last second. This tako is being cooked in both the proverbial and arguably literal oven, wondering whether it'll be well-made or undercooked. Likes to pair cookies with coffee, as well as use their free time to potato around and tune-in to the priestess' streams or clips."

author: Taiki Kiki
name: Taiki
description: "Separated from the watch of the Priestess, this lone Tako wanders around messing with other creatures by pulling pranks. It's adept in the art of metamorphosis for the sake of tricking others and has a natural curiosity for trying new things."

author: Jamuko
name: Jamutako
description: A tako who started wearing flowers for reasons long forgotten. Legend has it that this tako may have also been seen with particular flowers such as violets, meconopsis, and red camellias...

author: Mr. ShadowAnt
name: Mr. ShadowAnt
description: "While awake, this Tako can perform any task with utmost diligence, but once the sleepiness sets in, it takes rest seriously and cannot be woken by anything until it has fully recharged. As it naturally hardens and crystallizes its form while sleeping, it still can serve a purpose by being thrown or fired as a projectile while in this state."

author: Astraea
name: Astraeadachi
attributes: Easily Excited, full of curiosity. Made up of stardust and plasma on the surface, but a black hole resides within.
description: Once a stellar body, this star exploded and became a black hole. How it became a sentient celestial being? Who knows, but now it's a takodachi, watching with excitement from afar, and wanting to join their brethren even hundreds of light years away!

author: Ithi
name: Ithi
description: "Appears out of no where in Hazmat suit and the signature mask when things get a bit too hot. Sanitation freak. Will throw away your expired cookies, not without remorse and a single tear."

author: Jems
name: Jems the Takohog
description: "This Tako likes to be one with the wind, following it wherever it goes.This means it's actually very light and can be flung around easily. Nonetheless, it's good at dodging incoming attacks."

author: SharkyDoko
name: Kukki Doko
description: "One of the 'Shadow Observer' that has a sole duty to monitor and collect data according to the Priestess needs in the shadows. Specialized in underwater observations; by using his flowy body it allows him to get into very dedicate areas to monitor. Is unnaturally shy due to very limited contact with anyone else besides to the Priestess when receiving a new target to monitor."

author: Lyudmilia
name: Videnov
description: "A peculiar takodachi with no remarkable features except with it's notebook near it. It loves observing other takodachi and the priestess. Some rumors say, that it also sneaks for some cookies at night when all other takos are asleep."

author: Scalim
name: Scalim
description: This Optimistic Mage serves with a boundless sense of cheer, casting spells that shimmer with positivity and light. Despite their incredibly Squishy form, which isn't built for direct combat, their resilience is unmatched; they always bounce back with a smile. Their magic is often a shield of support and comfort, proving that true power comes not from brute force, but from an unwavering, hopeful heart.

author: Kurasu Kanon
name: Kanon
description: "This Tako prefers to lay on the floor of an air-conditioned room. Small though they may be, these round entities are some of the most numerous, and just like any other Tako, the Priestess's presence fills them with happiness."

author: Kaede, Acolyte of Wahtcher
name: Kaede Nakamura
description: "A Priestess from a parallel world, this humanoids Tako resides in a shrine dedicated to Wahtcher. There were more of her kind in her world, but they have fled to the void between worlds during a war. She has striking similarities to the priestess of AO, Ninomae Ina'nis. Kaede's main ability is spiritual healing, but has been known to have the ability to hop between dimensions, exorcise demons, and make use of her third eye. She prefers to stay hidden from the world, as her kind has had conflict with humans in the past."
